Perfect — the pantry has some great additions like **grilled chicken** (the girls will love this!), **Greek yoghurt**, and **spices**. Combined with the fridge, I have everything I need. Here are 5 days of lunchboxes! 🎒

---

# 👧👧 Twin Daughters' School Lunchbox Plan — 5 Days

> ✅ No heating required | ✅ Finger-friendly | ✅ Packed in 5 mins | ✅ Leak-proof friendly
> Every box includes: **protein + fruit + vegetable + carb + small treat**

---

## 📦 Monday — "Chicken & Rainbow Crunch"

| Category | Item |
|---|---|
| 🍗 Protein | Sliced grilled chicken pieces |
| 🥕 Vegetable | Baby carrots + watermelon radish coins *(use today — cut side won't last!)* |
| 🍊 Fruit | Small cup of orange juice + lemon wedge to drizzle |
| 🍞 Carb | Wholegrain crackers or rice cakes |
| 🍬 Treat | Small cube of feta cheese with olives |

> 💡 **Packing tip:** Pop the radish and carrots in a small sealed container with a splash of lemon juice to keep them crisp and fresh.

---

## 📦 Tuesday — "Egg & Veggie Muffin Box"

| Category | Item |
|---|---|
| 🥚 Protein | 2 mini hard-boiled eggs *(boil the night before!)* |
| 🥦 Vegetable | Blanched broccoli florets — easy to pick up and dip |
| 🍋 Fruit | Lemon-drizzled kohlrabi sticks (surprisingly sweet and crunchy!) |
| 🍞 Carb | Wholegrain crackers |
| 🍬 Treat | Small dollop of Greek yoghurt with a drizzle of honey (in a sealed tub) |

> 💡 **Packing tip:** Hard boil eggs the night before. Broccoli can be quickly blanched and cooled — stays firm for hours.

---

## 📦 Wednesday — "Chicken Salad Wrap Box"

| Category | Item |
|---|---|
| 🍗 Protein | Shredded grilled chicken |
| 🥬 Vegetable | Butter lettuce leaves + shredded red cabbage |
| 🍋 Fruit | Lemon wedge + OJ (finish up the OJ today!) |
| 🍞 Carb | Wholegrain wrap or flatbread — fill with chicken + lettuce, roll and slice |
| 🍬 Treat | Small handful of olives in a sealed mini container |

> 💡 **Packing tip:** Roll the wrap tightly in baking paper and slice in half — no utensils needed and it won't fall apart!

---

## 📦 Thursday — "Boiled Egg & Veggie Dip Box"

| Category | Item |
|---|---|
| 🥚 Protein | 2 hard-boiled eggs, peeled and halved |
| 🥕 Vegetable | Baby carrot sticks + sliced green bell pepper strips |
| 🥗 Fruit | Fresh beetroot sticks *(slightly sweet, kids love the colour!)* |
| 🍞 Carb | Wholegrain crackers or pitta triangles |
| 🍬 Treat | Greek yoghurt dip (in a small sealed tub) with a pinch of cumin for a mild Indian twist |

> 💡 **Packing tip:** Beetroot will stain, so wrap it in its own small container or zip bag to keep it separate!

---

## 📦 Friday — "Fun Friday Chicken & Feta Box" 🎉

| Category | Item |
|---|---|
| 🍗 Protein | Grilled chicken pieces + crumbled feta on the side |
| 🥬 Vegetable | Shredded white/napa cabbage with a squeeze of lemon |
| 🍊 Fruit | Carrot coins (sweet and crunchy — great snack!) |
| 🍞 Carb | Wholegrain crackers or mini rice cakes |
| 🍬 Treat | Small cup of Greek yoghurt with a tiny drizzle of honey 🍯 |

> 💡 **Packing tip:** Friday is a great day to clear the fridge — use up any remaining feta, cabbage, and carrots!

---

## 🛒 Quick Prep Notes for the Week

- **Tonight:** Hard boil 4 eggs (2 for Tuesday, 2 for Thursday) and store in the fridge — saves morning time!
- **Grilled chicken** is your best friend this week — slice or shred it in one go and portion into daily containers
- **Watermelon radish** must go on **Monday** — it's cut and won't last much longer
- **Orange juice** should be used by **Wednesday** at the latest

---

Would you like me to now plan the **full family dinner and breakfast plan** for the week too, or build a **shopping list** for anything that's running low? 😊
